identity_anchors: Distinctive yellow helmet and mustache shape
Asymmetrical crazy eye expression (one wide, one squinting)
Open mouth with visible teeth and drool/saliva drops
must_preserve: The specific silhouette of the yellow helmet and the long, drooping yellow mustache
The asymmetrical eye expression (wide left eye, narrowed right eye)
The open shouting mouth with blocky teeth
The flying saliva/drool drops near the mouth
The overall facial proportions and angry/excited expression
can_restyle: 3D rendering style (can be flattened, pixelated, or changed to other art styles)
Helmet material (can change from plastic-like to metal, fabric, etc., as long as shape remains)
must_not_replace_with: Generic barbarian or viking characters without the specific mustache/helmet shape
Cute or sanitized versions removing the aggressive expression or drool
Other Clash universe characters (like Archer or Wizard)
Abstract geometric shapes losing the facial features
color_preservation: The bright yellow of the helmet and mustache is critical for brand recognition against the purple background. The purple background is also a strong identity marker. Skin tone can vary slightly but should remain fleshy/peach. If theming, maintain high contrast between the yellow headgear and the background.
structure_summary: A tight close-up of a stylized 3D character head filling most of the frame. The composition relies on the bold yellow shapes of the helmet and mustache framing the expressive face. The background is a simple radial gradient. The identity is entirely character-driven rather than logo-text driven.
risk_notes: Removing the drool/saliva drops significantly reduces the recognizable 'crazy' personality of the icon
Changing the yellow color of the hair/helmet to another color will make it unrecognizable as the Clash Barbarian
Softening the expression too much (e.g., closing the mouth) destroys the brand's energetic identity
